Marmaduke Pickthall, Veiled Women.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/marmaduke-pickthall/veiled-women

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Marmaduke Pickthall, the author, died 1936.

First publication of the text used: 1913 (SE colophon: 'Veiled Women was published in 1913 by Marmaduke Pickthall.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1913, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so it entered by 2008.
- Country of origin (possible countries: the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths. The last to die did so in 1936, so the text entered the public domain in each of these countries on 1 January 2007.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
